description: Stereo delay from Surge, with an independent time per channel, cross-feed between the two lines, a filtered feedback path and an LFO over both times.

params.text: Pans the signal written into the delay lines, -100% fully left, 0% stereo and 100% fully right.
Sets the delay time of the left channel, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets the delay time of the right channel, 0.004 to 32 seconds, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets how much of each delayed channel is written back into its own delay line, 0 to 100%.
Sets how much of each delayed channel is written into the other channel's delay line, 0 to 100%.
Sets the corner of a high-pass filter on the delayed signal, 13.75Hz to 25kHz; every repeat passes through it again.
Sets the corner of a low-pass filter on the delayed signal, 13.75Hz to 25kHz; every repeat passes through it again.
Sets the rate of the LFO that modulates both delay times, 0.0078Hz to 512Hz, or a fraction of a beat when tempo-sync is on.
Sets how far the LFO moves the delay times, 0 to 200 cents.
Sets the stereo width of the delayed signal, -24dB to 24dB on the difference between the channels.
Sets how much delayed signal is mixed with the dry input, 0 to 100%.
Nothing in the module reads this knob; the delay has eleven parameters and the panel carries twelve knobs.
Scales both inputs before the effect processes them, from silence to unity gain.
Scales both outputs after the effect, from silence to unity gain.
Switches the left delay time from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by clock cv.
Switches the right delay time from seconds to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by clock cv.
Switches the LFO rate from Hz to a fraction of a beat at the tempo set by clock cv.

inputs.text: The left input into the effect; with the right input unpatched this one feeds both channels.
The right input into the effect.
Adds to the L/R Channel knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Left knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Right knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Feedback knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Crossfeed knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Low Cut knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the High Cut knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Rate knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Depth knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Width knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Adds to the Mix knob, a tenth of its full range per volt.
Nothing in the module reads this jack; the delay has eleven parameters and the panel carries twelve CV jacks.
Sets the tempo that tempo-synced times follow, doubling with every volt from 60 BPM at 0V, so 1V gives 120 BPM; with nothing patched the tempo is 120 BPM.

outputs.text: The left output of the effect; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.
The right output of the effect.

notes: the effect runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it delays the signal by 32 samples and reads its CV inputs once per block.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Preset — twelve factory settings: Init, Repeat, Ping-Pong 1-4, 1-8 and 1-16, Wide 1-4 and 1-8, Rhythmic 1, 2 and 3, Chorus (using Delay) and Wide Chorus (using Delay).
Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
